working_on.feature: Comprehensive R8 Minification, Retrofit & Network Architecture Fix
working_on.task: Completed Phase 04: End-to-End Release Build Verification & CI/CD Pipeline Assurance. All 4 phases completed.
working_on.notes: All 4 phases completed and verified with passing unit tests. Release v1.15 ready.

recent_changes.description: Implemented Phase 04: End-to-End Release Build Verification & CI/CD Pipeline Assurance. Created ReleaseBuildValidationTest verifying build configuration, absence of reckless ProGuard wildcards, and network component cohesion. Expanded AssetCleansingAndBuildOptimizationTest with Retrofit/Continuation ProGuard assertions. Updated CHANGELOG.md for Release v1.15. Verified via ReleaseBuildValidationTest.kt (3/3 passed).

Implemented Phase 03: Defensive Network Error Architecture & User-Friendly Translation. Created NetworkErrorResolver mapping technical exceptions to polite Vietnamese messages, shielding internal reflection details (ParameterizedType ClassCastException), automating session cookie recovery via HostingVerifier, and integrating across MainActivity and StoryDetailActivity. Verified via NetworkErrorResolverTest.kt (5/5 passed).

Implemented Phase 02: Resilient Data Model Serialization & Field Hardening. Added @androidx.annotation.Keep and explicit @SerializedName on all declared properties of Story, StoryListResponse, StoryDetailResponse, and RandomStoryResponse. Provided safe default initializers (emptyList, nulls, default primitives) to generate no-arg constructors for safe Gson instantiation. Verified via DataModelSerializationIntegrityTest.kt (5/5 passed).

Implemented Phase 01: R8 & ProGuard Rules Hardening for Retrofit & Kotlin Coroutines. Added official Square rules for kotlin.coroutines.Continuation, retrofit2.Call, retrofit2.Response, Gson TypeToken, AnnotationDefault, and conditional rules for @retrofit2.http.* interface methods. Configured android.enableR8.fullMode=false in gradle.properties. Verified via RetrofitR8ProGuardRulesTest.kt (7/7 passed).

errors_encountered.error: androidx.annotation.Keep has RetentionPolicy.CLASS (BINARY), causing clazz.getAnnotation(Keep::class.java) to return null at runtime reflection
errors_encountered.solution: Updated test verification to inspect the compiled class bytecode resource for the presence of the Keep descriptor (Landroidx/annotation/Keep;) in RuntimeInvisibleAnnotations

decisions_made.decision: Add comprehensive ReleaseBuildValidationTest to verify minified release configuration and network cohesion
decisions_made.reason: Prevents regression in release builds where R8 is active, ensuring keep rules are strictly enforced and no dangerous wildcards are added.

decisions_made.decision: Add explicit @SerializedName on 100% of fields in all network DTOs
decisions_made.reason: Prevents R8/ProGuard field renaming from desynchronizing JSON key mapping during Gson deserialization.

decisions_made.decision: Annotate Story, StoryListResponse, StoryDetailResponse, RandomStoryResponse with @androidx.annotation.Keep
decisions_made.reason: Protects classes and constructors from dead-code stripping, member optimization, and synthetic constructor removal under R8 optimization.

decisions_made.decision: Provide default values for DTO properties (e.g. status: String = '', data = emptyList()) to generate synthetic no-arg constructors
decisions_made.reason: Allows Gson to instantiate objects using standard constructor initialization with default values rather than bypassing constructors with sun.misc.Unsafe when keys are omitted.

decisions_made.decision: Add explicit -keep,allowoptimization,allowshrinking,allowobfuscation class kotlin.coroutines.Continuation to proguard-rules.pro
decisions_made.reason: Prevents R8 from stripping the generic Signature attribute on Continuation parameters in Retrofit suspend functions, resolving the java.lang.ClassCastException: java.lang.Class cannot be cast to java.lang.reflect.ParameterizedType runtime crash.

decisions_made.decision: Retain generic signatures of retrofit2.Call, retrofit2.Response, and Gson TypeToken
decisions_made.reason: Ensures runtime reflection and generic deserializers can determine the parameterized return types under R8 optimization.
